mapper.select: SELECT * FROM provider_commission_rule WHERE id = #{id} AND provider_id = #{providerId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO provider_commission_rule (provider_id, channel_fee_rate, principal_fee_rate, principal_commission_rate, downstream_fee_rate, downstream_commission_rate, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{providerId}, #{channelFeeRate}, #{principalFeeRate}, #{principalCommissionRate}, #{downstreamFeeRate}, #{downstreamCommissionRate}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE provider_commission_rule SET channel_fee_rate = #{channelFeeRate}, principal_fee_rate = #{principalFeeRate}, principal_commission_rate = #{principalCommissionRate}, downstream_fee_rate = #{downstreamFeeRate}, downstream_commission_rate = #{downstreamCommissionRate}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND provider_id = #{providerId}
